claim_scope: v1 (M1 / P3, item 01): tools/thv1_mutation_ledger_v1.py executes every mechanical mutation row of a test-hygiene packet in a fresh git-archive copy (pins checked against the copy, needle exactly once, killer green on an unmutated control copy and red on the mutated copy: pytest exit 1 or a cargo FAILED summary; a killer that still passes marks the row SURVIVED and the ledger exits 1; narrative rows are listed and never counted). tools/test_hygiene_evidence_v1.py closes the row schema to mechanical {description, killed_by, mutant: {path, needle, replacement}} with the path among the source pins and the killer a pinned pytest node or a pinned cargo test filter, or narrative {description, killed_by, narrative: true}; string-only rows survive only in packets dated before 20260903 as legacy replay records that no gate ever executed. tools/check_test_hygiene_v1.py counts rows by kind, verifies the needle count on every current pin, and refuses an added packet with legacy rows whatever its date. This packet's own rows are mechanical and executed by the ledger on itself. Research-only evidence; authority NONE; formal_core_complete stays false.
failure_modes: a packet claims a killer that passes under its mutant
a mutant edits an ambiguous or absent site
a killer that fails for an unrelated reason is counted as a kill
a narrative or legacy row is counted as executed evidence
a new packet keeps declaring string-only rows

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges one synthetic subject, packet, or run result, invokes one ledger or loader function, and asserts the exact verdict, count, or refusal.

reject_is_noop.reason: The ledger reads the worktree only through git archive and discards every copy; the worktree-untouched regression asserts the source bytes after a run.

nonclaims: The mutation ledger executes declared rows only; it does not measure mutants nobody declared.
A green ledger says nothing about code no row names; it makes the packet's mutation claims honest, not complete.
The ledger runs no Lean, verifies no receipts, mounts nothing, and raises no authority.
Legacy string-only rows in packets dated before 20260903 remain unexecuted historical records; the checker reports their count and nothing more.
